refusals.reason: The claim asserts that a genotype lesion causes or explains a phenotype. The bounded grammar contains no mechanism (no pathway, no quantitative gene-to-trait map), so turning the sentence into symbols and constraints would only restate the assertion, not check it. Association, mapping or perturbation evidence in a source supports the claim biologically; it is not a formalization.
what_would_be_needed: a mechanistic map from the lesion to the trait stated with declared symbols, units and domains (e.g. molecular consequence of the lesion on transcript/protein and the downstream quantity that defines the phenotype)
the source's evidence class for each link (observed association, perturbation/rescue, prediction) kept separate
scope: which population, background and conditions the mapping holds in
separately, only sequence-level facts (lengths, counts, coordinates) are checkable by counting; these are reported apart from the causal claim and say nothing about function
